remarks: Charming Cape Cod Retreat in Sought-After Cranbury. Come and experience this exceptional Cape Cod-style home in the peaceful and highly desirable neighborhood, right on the Wilton border. Blending timeless charm with modern open layout luxury, this residence offers a perfect balance of elegance, comfort, and convenience. Sunlight fills the inviting living room, where a wood-burning fireplace creates a cozy atmosphere for both relaxing and entertaining. The elegant dining room opens into a gourmet chef's kitchen featuring a premium Wolf range and hood, custom cabinetry, and high-end finishes throughout, leading to an ample size deck. A den, laundry/butler's room, two bedrooms with remodel one and half baths, attached garage complete the first floor offering plenty of flexibility for guests and family. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms, each with its own beautifully renovated en-suite bathroom a rare and luxurious feature. The finished lower level includes a comfortable Office/Rec/Play room. Outside, a large, flat yard provides the perfect space for entertaining, playing, or simply unwinding. Enjoy warm summer evenings or peaceful mornings on the inviting deck that overlooks the serene landscape. Located minutes from the Route 7 connector, Main Avenue shops and restaurants, and the Merritt 7 train station, this home combines modern living with classic New England charm. ADT Security installed.
